entities.name: Aymara Lupaca Reserved Zone
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Aymara Lupaca Reserved Zone was a protected area in southeastern Peru, set up in 1996, with an area of around 200,000 hectares. It was expanded in January 2006, but the decree was repealed in 2009.
